SELECT task.* FROM wf_task task INNER JOIN wf_process_instance instance ON instance.instance_id = task.instance_id AND instance.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND instance.deleted = 0 WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.proxy_user_id = #{userId} AND task.status = 'TODO'
AND instance.start_time >= #{query.startDate} AND instance.start_time < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND task.create_time >= #{query.startDate} AND task.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(instance.definition_id, instance.process_def_key) AS definition, COALESCE(definition.process_name, instance.process_def_key) AS definition_name, task.node_key AS node, task.node_name, task.assignee AS handler, task.assignee_name AS handler_name, DATE(task.create_time) AS business_date, 'TODO' AS fact_type, task.task_id AS todo_count, NULL AS handled_count, NULL AS duration_seconds, 0 AS integrity_error FROM wf_task task INNER JOIN wf_process_instance instance ON instance.instance_id = task.instance_id AND instance.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND instance.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wf_process_definition definition ON definition.definition_id = instance.definition_id AND definition.tenant_id = instance.tenant_id WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.status = 'TODO' AND task.create_time >= #{query.startDate} AND task.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND #{allowTodo} = TRUE
AND (task.assignee = #{userId} OR task.task_id IN #{taskId} )
UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(instance.definition_id, instance.process_def_key), COALESCE(definition.process_name, instance.process_def_key), history.node_key, history.node_name, COALESCE(history.on_behalf_of_user_id, history.operator_id), CASE WHEN history.on_behalf_of_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN history.on_behalf_of_user_name ELSE history.operator_name END, DATE(history.create_time), 'HANDLED', NULL, history.history_id, CASE WHEN history.duration_seconds >= 0 THEN history.duration_seconds ELSE NULL END, 0 FROM wf_task_history history INNER JOIN wf_process_instance instance ON instance.instance_id = history.instance_id AND instance.tenant_id = history.tenant_id AND instance.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wf_process_definition definition ON definition.definition_id = instance.definition_id AND definition.tenant_id = instance.tenant_id WHERE history.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND history.action IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT', 'COUNTERSIGN_APPROVE', 'COUNTERSIGN_REJECT') AND history.create_time >= #{query.startDate} AND history.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND #{allowHandled} = TRUE AND (history.operator_id = #{userId} OR history.on_behalf_of_user_id = #{userId}) ) fact
